notes: internal/execution/provenance.go:330 scrubDecision now covers all 9 string fields of store.DecisionRecord; the reflection test (provenance_test.go:404) holds decisionWords+decisionIdentifiers against the struct, so a future field cannot silently escape. Verified against internal/store/provenance.go:59-83 — every string field is in exactly one list, OccurredAt/AgentVersion are non-string and correctly skipped.

internal/execution/provenance.go:296 mergeFindings folds by class, so Finding.Sample keeps only the FIRST value seen. The stated justification (DecisionForTask copies Agent into Category, store/provenance.go:122) covers one pair of fields, but the dedup is applied across all nine: two DISTINCT rrn values in, say, Agent and Reasoning now surface to the operator as one finding with Count 2 and a single masked sample. Count is preserved and no value is left unredacted, so this is a deliberate fidelity tradeoff, not a leak — but it is broader than the duplicate-Category problem it is justified by.

internal/execution/provenance.go:94 exportScanDetails drops details["agent"] (the display name). The audit row still carries the agent by id (contentscan.go:140 writes resource_type="agent", resource_id=agentID), so the trail is still joinable; operators reading /admin/operations lose the human-readable name on dlp.export entries only. Checked web/src/pages/AdminDLP.tsx and the rest of web/src — nothing reads details.agent, so no UI breaks.

Commit message overstates one point: it says the audit-details leak "could not fire on that field at all" before this change. details["agent"] was always written verbatim; before, it merely needed a finding in Scenario/Reasoning/SourceURL to produce an entry at all. The leak pre-existed in a narrower form. Fix is still correct.

internal/execution/provenance_test.go:451 TestTheAuditEntryForAnExportCarriesNoScannedField only inspects map values that type-assert to string. A future details entry holding a struct or []any (e.g. "record": record) would slip past it. Narrow gap in an otherwise good guard.

internal/execution/provenancescan_live_test.go:36 the end-to-end proof that the stored audit row carries no value requires AGENTHUB_TEST_DSN and SKIPPED in this environment; only the in-memory details-map assertion actually ran. It also assumes pgx decodes the jsonb details column into map[string]any or []byte (line 100-107) — if it decodes to anything else, details stays nil and the findings==1 assertion fails rather than passing vacuously, which is the safe direction.

internal/execution/provenance.go:249,252 Outcome and Source are platform-generated enums (t.status, t.source), not "words somebody wrote" as the decisionWords doc comment claims. Harmless — no detector matches "completed"/"manual" — but slightly inconsistent with the stated rule. RuntimeImage is a new false-positive surface: the account detector pattern \\d{2,6}-\\d{2,6}-\\d{2,8} matches a dated version string like 2024-01-15, so a deployment with the account class on redact could see image versions rewritten in exported records.

internal/execution/contentpolicy_live_test.go:204 the liveAgent -> liveNamedAgent extraction is required by the new live test, not drive-by refactoring. No unrelated changes, no dependency bumps, no migrations. Pure code change, fully revertable.
